research.title: Research
research.intro: I want to understand how mitochondria supply the cell with energy, and what happens when they fail.
research.motivationHeading: From the bedside to the cell
research.motivationClinic: Eight years in hospital care showed me what a disease means for a person's daily life. I bring that perspective into research.
research.motivationMito: Mitochondria power the cell and carry their own genome. When they fail, the brain, the muscles and the liver are often affected at once.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.introText: This privacy notice explains which personal data is processed when you visit melinastutz.com. It follows the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).
privacy.controllerText: Melina Fabienne Stutz, Merenschwand AG, Switzerland. Reachable at the email address in the imprint.
privacy.visitText: When you open a page, your browser sends technically necessary information: IP address, date and time, the page requested, the referrer and the browser identifier. This information is used only to deliver the website, keep it running securely and find errors. It is not combined with other data and is kept only as long as needed for these purposes.
privacy.hostingText: The website runs on a privately operated server in Switzerland. Requests pass through the network of Cloudflare, Inc. (USA), which encrypts the connection and protects the website from attacks. Cloudflare may process the connection data listed above outside Switzerland as well. Cloudflare is certified under the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
privacy.noTrackingText: This website sets no cookies, uses no analytics or advertising services and loads no third-party content. The fonts are served by this website itself.
privacy.emailText: If you send an email, your details are used only to answer your enquiry and are not passed on to third parties.
privacy.rightsText: You can request information about your personal data and ask for it to be corrected or deleted. Write to the email address in the imprint. You can also lodge a complaint with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).
